surface: owner-authorized Mercury web transaction history (company account, owner's own browser session)
acquisition: The owner's signed-in browser issued its own first-page transactions-lite request; the response was handed to the verifier code locally without exporting cookies or headers.
limitations: Runs the reviewed reference oracle, field minimization and the compiled Wasm adapter on live data; it does not test credential replay or the Nitro relay path.
The browser request used the owner's timezone; the enclave reader pins UTC and that variant is still untested against Mercury.

Replaying a company web session (cookies plus device-bound headers) from an AWS IP may be rejected or trip fraud controls; a read-only Mercury API token is the preferred enclave credential and needs its own reviewed adapter surface.
Bank-reported sent status does not establish recipient credit or irreversible settlement.
